style: Hastily sketched 1950s mid-century modern editorial spot illustration, in the lively, witty ink-and-spot-color spirit of 1950s Party Cookbook (Cocktails for a Few), Kiddie Cocktails, and Jim Flora / Ronald Searle / vintage New Yorker pen drawings. Energetic, loose, uneven hand-drawn black fountain-pen ink lines with variable nib thickness, quick squiggles, and imperfect sketchy contours, paired with 2 or 3 loose, dry-textured flat screenprint/gouache color shapes (vermilion coral-red, warm ochre mustard, olive-chartreuse) that playfully slip slightly outside the ink lines (off-register 1950s print look) on generous open warm cream paper. Strictly NO clean vector art, NO uniform SVG outlines, NO symmetrical clipart, NO smooth digital shapes, NO photorealism, NO 3D, NO gradients. Full-bleed edge-to-edge on warm cream paper: no book pages, no borders, no captions, no words, no text, no signatures anywhere.

style_variants.name: 2B-loose-hand-inked
style_variants.prompt: Charming 1950s mid-century modern hand-drawn ink and flat screenprint spot illustration, in the breezy, witty editorial spirit of 1950s Party Cookbook, Festive Buffet Cookery, and Saul Bass / Jim Flora / vintage New Yorker spot drawings. Loose, expressive, slightly wobbly hand-drawn black fountain-pen ink outlines paired with 2 or 3 slightly off-register flat matte gouache/screenprint color blocks (vermilion coral-red, warm ochre mustard, olive-chartreuse) on generous open warm cream paper (50% open cream breathing room). Playful, organic mid-century asymmetry—NOT stiff modern flat vector graphics, NOT symmetrical clipart, NO crosshatching, NO shading gradients, NO photorealism, NOT 3D. Full-bleed edge-to-edge on warm cream paper: no book pages, no borders, no captions, no text, no signatures anywhere.

prompts.hero: Hastily sketched 1950s editorial spot illustration (no text, no people, lots of open warm cream paper): a jaunty hand-sketched oval platter seen at a lively angle holding five loosely scribbled twice-baked potato halves with fluffy whipped peaks, quick ink squiggles of chives, and playful off-register coral-red paprika specks; floating lightly in the open upper cream space, two crookedly charming hand-sketched brass candlesticks with flickering ink flames and a quick sketchy coral-red roast turkey silhouette resting on a loose off-register mustard table block.
prompts.s1: Hastily sketched 1950s spot illustration on generous open cream paper: a loose sketchy black cast-iron skillet over quick jagged coral-red ink flames, filled with scribbled brick-red sausage bits and a crooked wooden spoon stirring, beside a small sketched plate of drained sausage crumbles. Off-register flat spot colors slipping slightly past the ink lines.
prompts.s2: Hastily sketched 1950s spot illustration on open cream paper: an energetic ink-sketched baking pan holding four loosely drawn oval russet potatoes dotted with quick salt flecks, beside two sketchy garlic bulbs sitting on jagged silver-grey foil squares with off-register mustard highlights.
prompts.s3: Hastily sketched 1950s spot illustration on open cream paper: a lively hand-drawn saucepan with a puff of golden ochre foam, beside a sketchy tin box grater and three loose wedges of cheese with scribbled little grated mounds on a quick-inked wooden board.
prompts.s4: Hastily sketched 1950s spot illustration on open cream paper: two expressive, hastily drawn 1950s ink hands in a striped tea towel holding a baked potato half and scooping a loose fluffy potato cloud with a sketchy spoon into a cream bowl, with three empty potato skins sketched beside it.
prompts.s5: Hastily sketched 1950s spot illustration on open cream paper: a quirky hand-inked hand-crank food mill perched on a sketchy cream bowl, with loose squiggly ribbons of milled white potato tumbling down and a couple of golden roasted garlic cloves on a tiny saucer.
prompts.s6: Hastily sketched 1950s spot illustration on open cream paper: top-down sketchy circle of a cream bowl of mashed potato dotted with quick olive chive flicks and coral-red sausage bits, stirred by a bright vermilion spatula, surrounded by loose hand-drawn shapes for sour cream, cream cheese, butter, and a cream pitcher.
prompts.s7: Hastily sketched 1950s spot illustration on open cream paper: a loosely drawn baking pan holding four potato boat shells piled with scribbly fluffy filling and off-register ochre cheese flecks, plus a quick-inked spoon.
prompts.s8: Hastily sketched 1950s spot illustration on open cream paper: three steaming golden twice-baked potato halves on a sketchy pan, a lively ink-drawn hand shaking a tiny wire sieve with a shower of coral-red paprika dots, and two tiny bowls of red crumbles and green chives.
